brief:
For the fourth consecutive winter, rainfall has exposed severe shortages of construction materials needed for shelter in Gaza, Middle East Eye reported. The restrictions limit supplies entering the strip, leaving residents vulnerable to weather conditions.

Winter flooding and inadequate housing compound existing humanitarian challenges across the territory. Aid organizations have warned of worsening conditions as temperatures drop and precipitation increases.
dek: How Gaza’s winter ‘crisis’ is manufactured by Israel For the fourth winter in a row, rains have swept through Gaza, exposing woefully inadequate supplies of materials for shelter entering the strip.
title: Israel restricts shelter materials into Gaza ahead of winter rains
